evidence.observation: Pressure begins drifting upward from ~2.98 Torr baseline at fixed 100 sccm Ar
Pressure now 3.275 Torr and monotonically rising during growth, ~10% above ramp baseline
MFC steady at ~100 sccm, so rise is not a flow increase
Brief 10 °C overshoot at growth onset, since settled to setpoint

args.missing_evidence: Whether pressure keeps climbing (exhaust blockage) or plateaus; an Ar-flow step or pump-valve test would discriminate blockage from a leak, and O2 sensor is not installed to check air ingress.
